question: For whose sin does the Lord say his people will be removed into all kingdoms?
explanation: I will cause them to be removed into all kingdoms of the earth, because of Manasseh the son of Hezekiah king of Judah.

question: What four kinds does the Lord appoint over the people?
choices: The sword, dogs, fowls and beasts
explanation: I will appoint over them four kinds: the sword to slay, and the dogs to tear, and the fowls of the heaven, and the beasts of the earth, to devour and destroy.

question: What does the Lord say he is weary with?
explanation: Thou hast forsaken me, saith the LORD, thou art gone backward: therefore will I stretch out my hand against thee; I am weary with repenting.

question: How does Jeremiah describe himself in his woe?
choices: A man of strife and contention to the whole earth
explanation: Woe is me, my mother, that thou hast borne me a man of strife and a man of contention to the whole earth!

question: What will the Lord make Jeremiah to this people?
explanation: I will make thee unto this people a fenced brasen wall: and they shall fight against thee, but they shall not prevail against thee.

question: What does the Lord promise to cause the enemy to do to Jeremiah’s remnant?
choices: Entreat them well in the time of affliction
explanation: Verily it shall be well with thy remnant; verily I will cause the enemy to entreat thee well in the time of evil and in the time of affliction.

question: What does Jeremiah say he never did, yet every one curses him?
explanation: I have neither lent on usury, nor men have lent to me on usury; yet every one of them doth curse me.

question: What will the Lord do with a fan in the gates of the land?
choices: Fan them and bereave them of children
explanation: I will fan them with a fan in the gates of the land; I will bereave them of children, I will destroy my people.

question: What are the widows increased above?
explanation: Their widows are increased to me above the sand of the seas.

question: What will the Lord give to the spoil without price?
explanation: Thy substance and thy treasures will I give to the spoil without price, and that for all thy sins, even in all thy borders.

question: Where did Jeremiah say he did not sit, but sat alone?
choices: In the assembly of the mockers
In the court of the temple
explanation: I sat not in the assembly of the mockers, nor rejoiced; I sat alone because of thy hand.

question: What does Jeremiah say about his pain and wound?
choices: His pain is perpetual and his wound incurable
explanation: Why is my pain perpetual, and my wound incurable, which refuseth to be healed?

question: What will Jeremiah be if he takes forth the precious from the vile?
choices: As a priest in the temple
explanation: If thou take forth the precious from the vile, thou shalt be as my mouth.

question: Why can Jeremiah say he is called by the Lord’s name?
choices: Because he was born a priest
Because he found the Lord’s words and ate them
Because he stood before the king
explanation: Thy words were found, and I did eat them: for I am called by thy name, O LORD God of hosts.

question: What does Jeremiah ask the Lord to do for him against his persecutors?
explanation: O LORD, thou knowest: remember me, and visit me, and revenge me of my persecutors.

question: What did the Lord bring at noonday against the mother of the young men?
explanation: I have brought upon them against the mother of the young men a spoiler at noonday.

question: What does the Lord ask about iron?
choices: Shall iron break the northern iron and the steel?
Can iron be turned to gold?
Who shall forge iron for Judah?
explanation: Shall iron break the northern iron and the steel?

question: What three things does the Lord ask about who would pity Jerusalem?
choices: Who shall pity, bemoan, or ask how she does
Who shall build, plant, or reap
Who shall judge, speak, or hear
Who shall lead, guard, or feed
explanation: Who shall have pity upon thee, O Jerusalem? or who shall bemoan thee? or who shall go aside to ask how thou doest?

question: What is said of the woman who hath borne seven?
choices: She languishes and her sun is gone down while it was yet day
explanation: She that hath borne seven languisheth: she hath given up the ghost; her sun is gone down while it was yet day.

question: Into what land will the Lord make them pass with their enemies?
explanation: I will make thee to pass with thine enemies into a land which thou knowest not.

question: What does Jeremiah ask the Lord not to do in his longsuffering?
explanation: Take me not away in thy longsuffering: know that for thy sake I have suffered rebuke.

question: What must Jeremiah not do, though the people may return to him?
explanation: Let them return unto thee; but return not thou unto them.

question: From whom will the Lord redeem Jeremiah?
explanation: I will deliver thee out of the hand of the wicked, and I will redeem thee out of the hand of the terrible.

question: Why did Jeremiah sit alone?
choices: The people had cast him out
The Lord had filled him with indignation
explanation: I sat alone because of thy hand: for thou hast filled me with indignation.

question: Why will the Lord destroy his people?
choices: Since they return not from their ways
explanation: I will destroy my people, since they return not from their ways.

question: What did the Lord cause to fall suddenly on the city?
explanation: I have caused him to fall upon it suddenly, and terrors upon the city.

question: What will the Lord do with the residue of the people?
choices: Deliver them to the sword before their enemies
explanation: The residue of them will I deliver to the sword before their enemies, saith the LORD.

question: Why will the people fight Jeremiah but not prevail?
choices: The Lord is with him to save and deliver him
explanation: They shall not prevail against thee: for I am with thee to save thee and to deliver thee, saith the LORD.

question: Why does the Lord say he will cast the people out of the land?
choices: Their fathers forsook him and walked after other gods
explanation: Because your fathers have forsaken me, and have walked after other gods, and have served them, and have worshipped them, and have not kept my law.

question: Where is Jeremiah told not to go to sit and eat and drink?
explanation: Thou shalt not also go into the house of feasting, to sit with them to eat and to drink.

question: What voices will the Lord cause to cease out of this place?
choices: Mirth, gladness, the bridegroom and the bride
explanation: I will cause to cease out of this place the voice of mirth, and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom, and the voice of the bride.

question: What will become of those who die of grievous deaths?
choices: They shall be buried in the temple
Unlamented, unburied, as dung on the earth
They shall be mourned by all
explanation: They shall not be lamented; neither shall they be buried; but they shall be as dung upon the face of the earth.

question: What does the Lord say about the people’s ways?
choices: His eyes are upon all of them and none is hid
He sees only the priests’ ways
explanation: Mine eyes are upon all their ways: they are not hid from my face, neither is their iniquity hid from mine eyes.

question: After the fishers, whom will the Lord send to hunt them?
explanation: After will I send for many hunters, and they shall hunt them from every mountain, and from every hill, and out of the holes of the rocks.

question: What will happen to the children born in the place where Jeremiah lives?
choices: They will die of grievous deaths
explanation: Concerning the sons and the daughters that are born in this place: they shall die of grievous deaths.

question: What have the people done worse than their fathers?
choices: Walked after the imagination of their evil heart
explanation: Ye have done worse than your fathers; for, behold, ye walk every one after the imagination of his evil heart.

question: Where will the people serve other gods day and night?
choices: In a land they and their fathers know not
explanation: I will cast you out of this land into a land that ye know not; and there shall ye serve other gods day and night.

question: Why will the Lord recompense their iniquity double?
choices: They defiled his land with their detestable things
explanation: I will recompense their iniquity and their sin double; because they have defiled my land.

question: From where will the hunters hunt the people?
choices: Every mountain, hill and hole of the rocks
explanation: They shall hunt them from every mountain, and from every hill, and out of the holes of the rocks.

question: What does Jeremiah call the Lord when the Gentiles come to him?
choices: His strength, fortress and refuge in the day of affliction
explanation: O LORD, my strength, and my fortress, and my refuge in the day of affliction.

question: What does the Lord ask about men making gods?
choices: Who shall pull down the gods?
Will the gods save the nations?
Shall a man make gods unto himself, and they are no gods?
Where are the gods of the north?
explanation: Shall a man make gods unto himself, and they are no gods?

question: What will the Lord cause the people to know this once?
choices: His hand and his might, and that his name is The LORD
explanation: I will this once cause them to know mine hand and my might; and they shall know that my name is The LORD.

question: What will no one give the mourners in the day of death?
choices: The cup of consolation to drink
explanation: Neither shall men give them the cup of consolation to drink for their father or for their mother.

question: Why does the Lord say he has taken away peace from the people?
choices: To take away his lovingkindness and mercies
explanation: I have taken away my peace from this people, saith the LORD, even lovingkindness and mercies.

question: What will the bodies of the dead be for the fowls and beasts?
explanation: Their carcases shall be meat for the fowls of heaven, and for the beasts of the earth.

question: Who shall die in this land and not be buried?
choices: Both the great and the small
explanation: Both the great and the small shall die in this land: they shall not be buried, neither shall men lament for them.

question: What would men not do for the dead, nor make themselves?
choices: Cut themselves, or make themselves bald
explanation: Nor cut themselves, nor make themselves bald for them.

question: What will the people ask when Jeremiah shows them these words?
choices: What is our iniquity, what is our sin?
explanation: Wherefore hath the LORD pronounced all this great evil against us? or what is our iniquity? or what is our sin?

question: With what had the people filled the Lord’s inheritance?
choices: The carcases of their detestable and abominable things
explanation: They have filled mine inheritance with the carcases of their detestable and abominable things.

question: What will the nations say their fathers inherited?
choices: Lies, vanity and things with no profit
explanation: Surely our fathers have inherited lies, vanity, and things wherein there is no profit.

question: From where will the Gentiles come to the Lord?
choices: From the ends of the earth
explanation: The Gentiles shall come unto thee from the ends of the earth.

question: Into which land will the Lord bring the people again?
choices: The land he gave to their fathers
explanation: I will bring them again into their land that I gave unto their fathers.

question: How much will the Lord first recompense their iniquity?
explanation: And first I will recompense their iniquity and their sin double.

question: What will the Lord not show them in the land of exile?
explanation: There shall ye serve other gods day and night; where I will not shew you favour.

question: In what day is the Lord Jeremiah’s strength, fortress and refuge?
explanation: O LORD, my refuge in the day of affliction, the Gentiles shall come unto thee.

question: Who besides the children shall die of grievous deaths?
explanation: Concerning their mothers that bare them, and concerning their fathers that begat them in this land; they shall die of grievous deaths.

question: What is the man who trusts in the LORD like?
choices: A tree planted by the waters
explanation: He shall be as a tree planted by the waters, and that spreadeth out her roots by the river.

question: What is the man who trusts in man like?
explanation: He shall be like the heath in the desert, and shall not see when good cometh.

question: What does the LORD say he does with the heart?
choices: Searches it and tries the reins
explanation: I the LORD search the heart, I try the reins, even to give every man according to his ways, and according to the fruit of his doings.

question: What bird pictures the man who gets riches by wrong?
choices: The partridge that sits on eggs and hatches them not
explanation: As the partridge sitteth on eggs, and hatcheth them not; so he that getteth riches, and not by right, shall leave them in the midst of his days.

question: What does Jeremiah call the LORD, whom all who forsake him will be ashamed of leaving?
explanation: O LORD, the hope of Israel, all that forsake thee shall be ashamed: because they have forsaken the LORD, the fountain of living waters.

question: What were the people told not to bear on the sabbath day?
explanation: Take heed to yourselves, and bear no burden on the sabbath day, nor bring it in by the gates of Jerusalem.

question: What will happen to the city if the people hallow the sabbath?
explanation: If ye diligently hearken unto me, to hallow the sabbath day, then this city shall remain for ever.

question: What will the Lord kindle if the people will not hallow the sabbath?
choices: A fire in the gates that shall devour the palaces
A fire in the temple only
explanation: Then will I kindle a fire in the gates thereof, and it shall devour the palaces of Jerusalem, and it shall not be quenched.

question: What does Jeremiah ask the Lord to do for him?
explanation: Heal me, O LORD, and I shall be healed; save me, and I shall be saved: for thou art my praise.

question: Where is Judah’s sin graven besides the table of their heart?
choices: Upon the horns of their altars
Upon the pillars of the porch
explanation: The sin of Judah is graven upon the table of their heart, and upon the horns of your altars.

question: What do their children remember by the green trees on the high hills?
explanation: Whilst their children remember their altars and their groves by the green trees upon the high hills.

question: What will the Lord give to the spoil from “my mountain in the field”?
choices: Her substance, treasures and high places
explanation: O my mountain in the field, I will give thy substance and all thy treasures to the spoil, and thy high places for sin.

question: What is true of the blessed man’s leaf in the year of drought?
choices: It stays green and he does not stop yielding fruit
explanation: Her leaf shall be green; and shall not be careful in the year of drought, neither shall cease from yielding fruit.

question: Where will the man who trusts in man dwell?
choices: The parched places in a salt land
explanation: But shall inhabit the parched places in the wilderness, in a salt land and not inhabited.

question: What will the man who gets riches by wrong be at his end?
explanation: He that getteth riches, and not by right, shall leave them in the midst of his days, and at his end shall be a fool.

question: What is “the place of our sanctuary” called?
choices: A glorious high throne from the beginning
explanation: A glorious high throne from the beginning is the place of our sanctuary.

question: Where shall those who depart from the Lord be written?
explanation: They that depart from me shall be written in the earth, because they have forsaken the LORD.

question: What do the people say to Jeremiah?
choices: Where is the word of the LORD? Let it come now
explanation: Behold, they say unto me, Where is the word of the LORD? let it come now.

question: What does Jeremiah say he did not hasten to do?
choices: Hasten from being a pastor to follow the Lord
Hasten to speak in the gate
explanation: As for me, I have not hastened from being a pastor to follow thee: neither have I desired the woeful day.

question: What does Jeremiah ask the Lord not to be to him?
explanation: Be not a terror unto me: thou art my hope in the day of evil.

question: What would the people bring to the Lord’s house from the cities of Judah?
choices: Burnt offerings, incense and sacrifices of praise
explanation: Bringing burnt offerings, and sacrifices, and meat offerings, and incense, and bringing sacrifices of praise, unto the house of the LORD.

question: Who would enter the city gates if the sabbath were hallowed?
choices: Kings and princes of David’s throne in chariots
explanation: Then shall there enter into the gates of this city kings and princes sitting upon the throne of David, riding in chariots and on horses.

question: What does Jeremiah ask for his persecutors?
choices: That they be confounded and doubly destroyed
explanation: Let them be confounded that persecute me: bring upon them the day of evil, and destroy them with double destruction.

question: With what is Judah’s sin written, besides a pen of iron?
explanation: The sin of Judah is written with a pen of iron, and with the point of a diamond.

question: What will the heath in the desert not see?
explanation: He shall be like the heath in the desert, and shall not see when good cometh.

question: What does the heart do besides being deceitful?
explanation: The heart is deceitful above all things, and desperately wicked: who can know it?

question: Which tribe’s land is named among those the offerings come from?
explanation: They shall come from the cities of Judah, and from the land of Benjamin, and from the plain, and from the mountains, and from the south.

question: Whom had the Lord commanded to hallow the sabbath?
explanation: Hallow ye the sabbath day, as I commanded your fathers.

question: Besides carrying burdens out of their houses, what must they not do on the sabbath?
explanation: Neither carry forth a burden out of your houses on the sabbath day, neither do ye any work, but hallow ye the sabbath day.

question: Where is Jeremiah told to stand and speak?
choices: In the gate by which the kings of Judah come in and go out
explanation: Go and stand in the gate of the children of the people, whereby the kings of Judah come in, and by the which they go out.

question: Where will the Lord cause the people to serve their enemies?
choices: In a land which they know not
explanation: I will cause thee to serve thine enemies in the land which thou knowest not.

question: What does Jeremiah say about the words that came out of his lips?
choices: They were right before the Lord
explanation: That which came out of my lips was right before thee.

question: What had Jeremiah not desired?
explanation: Neither have I desired the woeful day; thou knowest.

question: What does the Lord say about the fire of his anger?
explanation: Ye have kindled a fire in mine anger, which shall burn for ever.

question: What did the fathers do instead of listening to the Lord?
explanation: They obeyed not, neither inclined their ear, but made their neck stiff, that they might not hear, nor receive instruction.

question: Whom is Jeremiah to address at the gates?
choices: The kings of Judah and all in Jerusalem
explanation: Hear ye the word of the LORD, ye kings of Judah, and all Judah, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, that enter in by these gates.
